user.title: New station
user.description: A station groups the devices that are built into one piece of furniture. Every device or entity that carries the station's label is part of the station. Leave the label empty to create a new label with the station's name.

data_description.label_id: Use an existing label, or leave empty to create one.
data_description.power_on_label: Leave empty to use the label "Power on" (created when missing). Power on switches on everything in the station with this label, presses labelled buttons and runs labelled scripts and scenes.
data_description.power_off_label: Leave empty to use the label "Power off" (created when missing). When nothing in the station has this label, Power off switches off what Power on switched on.
data_description.use_power_labels: Power on and Power off act on everything in the station with the labels below.

error.label_in_use: This label is already used by station {station}. Choose another label.
error.name_label_in_use: A label with this name is already used by station {station}. Choose a label, or use another name.

abort.already_configured: This label already belongs to another station.
